schema: contenders-foundation fuel evidence v1 (engine 1.0.2, CLI/SDK 3.0.4, release builds via arena run-batch --release)
tables: fuel-costs.csv: net fuel = median(fuel_remaining() delta) - median(noop delta, 15); columns lab30 (fuel-small 30x30), lab100 (fuel-large 100x100, same local layout), packs31 (00packs), ambush100 (00ambush), bigw100 (01big_world); 'action ...' rows are single raw deltas. lab100 'bitboard positions() many bits' is invalid (one call ~90K exceeds the turn; sample spanned an exhaustion).

static_init_before_main.note: includes cambc::champion_designs (13 design champions; one champion{type} construct = 552) ~7.2K, draft_memory snapshot ~1.5K, terrain/spawn masks, settings

distance_field_model: fuel ~= (16 + E) * chunks, chunks = ceil(W/8)*ceil(H/8) (16 on 30x30, 169 on 100x100), E = BFS expansions (max distance reached); fit on 100x100: 2754 + 169 E
map_camp_groups_model: ~930 per group + ~105 per camp (+~100): fuel-small 7 groups/8 camps 7.3K, 00packs 8/42 12.7K, 00ambush 12/46 16.1K, 01big_world 24/92 32.0K

exhaustion.pre_loop_move: applied in round 67 (replay Move step r67)
exhaustion.replay_step: TurnRollover (kind 26) for the actor in r67, then its turnEnd tick still runs
exhaustion.fuel_stream: turn#201 (r67, c0) = 100000 (exactly the budget); turn#204 (r68, c0) = 75823
exhaustion.resumption: round 68 turn resumes inside the busy loop: local round 67, round_number() 68, fresh 100000 budget; the post-loop move applied in round 68; no new turn-start code ran in r68
exhaustion.statistics: events kind fuelExhausted, one entry per exhausted turn: {amount 0.0, context '0', target 0, timestamp {input 431, ordinal 6970, phase 'champions', round 67, substep 0}, value '1', x 0, y 0}, owner {id 0, kind champion, name 'Vesper Vale', team teamA}; diagnostics.botFaults 0
exhaustion.arena: arena play summary counts it as 'exhausted' and 'suspended'
